[Story]
Emma is a leader of a software development team, she always dreams of introducing new technology to improve team efficiency. However, her team recently receives a new big project, which needs to be completed as soon as possible. The client is willing to pay extra fees to ensure the project is prioritized. Therefore, Emma decides to temporarily give up the plan to introduce new technology and devotes herself to completing this big project.

[Question]
What does Emma do after she completes this big project?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Emma uses these extra fees for personal investment.
B. Emma donates these extra fees to a charity organization.
C. Emma uses these extra fees to take the team members on vacation.
D. Emma uses these extra fees to introduce new technology for the team.
